brief:
Humanitarian organizations issued an urgent appeal Friday for swift entry of winter supplies into Gaza, warning that lives are at stake, UN News reported. The call came days after deadly rainfall struck the territory over the weekend, compounding existing hardships for the population.

Winter conditions are approaching as the territory faces ongoing supply shortages. No further details were provided on the death toll or scale of damage from the rainfall or specific supply needs cited by the UN and partner organizations.
dek: Winter supplies must enter the Gaza Strip where “lives are at stake”, the UN and partners said in an urgent appeal on Friday, in the wake of deadly rainfall this past weekend.
title: UN urges immediate delivery of winter supplies to Gaza
